description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Earth 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Critical Link G] and [True Gladiolus Link] to the user

description.name: Attach Earth 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Critical Link G
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Heavy Impact or Tempest Charge (0~3), grants [Critical Link G Critical Chance and Cast Speed] after using Heavy Impact or Tempest Charge

description.name: True Gladiolus Link
description.text: Grants [Attach Earth] to the user after using three of Heavy Impact or Tempest Charge
